title: Design, synthesis, anticancer evaluation, in silico docking and ADMET analysis of novel indole-based thalidomide analogs as promising immunomodulatory agents.
authors: El-Zahabi, Mohamed Ayman; Elkady, Hazem; Sakr, Helmy; Abdelraheem, Adel S; Eissa, Sally I; El-Adl, Khaled
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计合成吲哚沙利度胺类似物并评估抗癌与免疫调节活性，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: In the present work, novel 16 indole-based thalidomide analogs were designed and synthesized to obtain new effective antitumor immunomodulatory agents. The synthesized compounds were evaluated for their cytotoxic activities against HepG-2, HCT-116, PC3 and MCF-7 cell lines. Generally, the opened analogs of glutarimide ring exhibited higher activities than the closed ones. Compounds 21a-b and 11d,g showed strong potencies against all tested cell lines with IC(50) values ranging from 8.27 to 25.20 microM comparable to that of thalidomide (IC(50) values ranging from 32.12 to 76.91 microM). The most active compounds were further evaluated for their in vitro immunomodulatory activities via estimation of human tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha), human caspase-8 (CASP8), human vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), and nuclear factor kappa-B P65 (NF-kappaB P65) in HCT-116 cells. Thalidomide was used as a positive control. Compounds 11g, 21a and 21b showed remarkable significant reduction in TNF-alpha. Furthermore, compounds 11g, 21a and 21b showed significant elevation in CASP8 levels. Compounds 11g and 21a significantly inhibited VEGF. In addition, derivatives 11d, 11g and 21a showed significant decrease in level of NF-kappaB p65. Moreover, our derivatives exhibited good in silico docking and ADMET profile.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，设计并合成了16种新型吲哚类沙利度胺类似物，以获取新的高效抗肿瘤免疫调节剂。对所合成化合物针对HepG-2、HCT-116、PC3和MCF-7细胞系的细胞毒性活性进行了评估。总体而言，戊二酰亚胺环开环类似物表现出比闭环类似物更高的活性。化合物21a-b和11d,g对所有测试细胞系均显示出强效，其IC(50)值范围为8.27至25.20微摩尔，与沙利度胺（IC(50)值范围为32.12至76.91微摩尔）相当。对最具活性的化合物进一步评估了其体外免疫调节活性，通过在HCT-116细胞中检测人肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha）、人胱天蛋白酶-8（CASP8）、人血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）和核因子κB P65（NF-kappaB P65）来实现。沙利度胺作为阳性对照。化合物11g、21a和21b显示出显著的TNF-alpha降低作用。此外，化合物11g、21a和21b显著提高了CASP8水平。化合物11g和21a显著抑制了VEGF。另外，衍生物11d、11g和21a显著降低了NF-kappaB p65水平。此外，我们的衍生物表现出良好的计算机模拟对接和ADMET特性。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
